counting.name: Counting
counting.says: The count starts at nothing and is never more than ten.

done.name: Ten
done.says: Reaching ten exactly is the end.

step.name: Add one, two or three
step.says: Each step adds one, two or three to the count.

last-step.name: Add one, two or three
last-step.says: A step that makes the count exactly ten is the last one.

no-overshoot.says: A step that would take the count past ten is not offered.
